easy.example: The cheetah is a rapid runner.

more.def: Very quick; happening in a short time.
more.example: The river's rapid water carried the raft downstream.

easy.def: Not seen or found very much.
easy.example: It is rare to see snow here.

more.def: Not common; not often seen, found, or happening.
more.example: The zoo has a rare white tiger.

easy.def: To know someone or something because you have seen it before.
easy.example: I recognize that dog. It lives next door.

more.def: To know who or what something is because you have seen or heard it before.
more.example: I did not recognize my cousin with his new haircut.

easy.def: To use old things again to make new things.

more.def: To turn used materials into something new instead of throwing them away.
more.example: Our school recycles plastic bottles to help keep the Earth clean.

easy.def: To show a picture back, like a mirror does.

more.def: To throw back light, heat, sound, or an image from a surface.
more.example: The calm water reflected the mountains like a mirror.

easy.example: I relax with a good book.

more.def: To rest and become calm and less worried.
more.example: After the test, the students could finally relax.

easy.def: To keep something in your mind.
easy.example: I remember my first day of school.

more.def: To bring something back into your mind, or to not forget it.
more.example: Remember to bring your lunch on the field trip.

easy.def: An animal with dry skin and scales, like a snake.

more.def: A cold-blooded animal with dry, scaly skin that usually lays eggs.
more.example: Snakes, lizards, and crocodiles are all reptiles.

easy.example: The firefighter will rescue the cat from the tree.

more.def: To save someone or something from danger or harm.
more.example: A lifeguard rescued the swimmer who was too tired to reach the shore.

easy.def: Being nice and caring about how others feel.
easy.example: We show respect when we listen.

more.def: A feeling that someone or something is important and should be treated well.
more.example: We show respect for our classmates by listening when they speak.

easy.def: Doing the things you are supposed to do.
easy.example: I am responsible for feeding my cat.

more.def: Able to be trusted to do what is right or what you are supposed to do.
more.example: A responsible pet owner makes sure the dog gets a walk every day.

easy.def: A nice thing you get for doing something good.
easy.example: I got a sticker as a reward.

more.def: Something given to you for doing something good or helpful.
more.example: The family offered a reward for finding their lost cat.

more.def: Having an uneven or bumpy surface; not smooth or gentle.
more.example: The rough bark of the tree scratched my hand.

easy.def: A story people tell that may not be true.
easy.example: I heard a rumor that we will get a new slide.

more.def: A story that is passed from person to person and may or may not be true.
more.example: There was a rumor that school would close early.
